snp5.15:1.1: To one who reveals the past
snp5.15:1.4:
who has gone to the beyond
of all phenomena,
snp5.15:1.5: I’ve come with a desire for a question.
snp5.15:2.1:
I ask the Sakyan about the knowledge
of one devoid of perception of forms,
snp5.15:2.2:
who has abandoned all the body,
every body,
snp5.15:2.3:
who sees, within & without,
‘There is nothing’:
snp5.15:2.6:
How is he
to be led further on?
snp5.15:3.1:
The Buddha:
The Tathāgata, knowing directly
snp5.15:3.4: knows for one stationed in them
snp5.15:4.2:
the origin of nothingness
to be the fetter of delight,
snp5.15:4.6:
the brahman who has lived
to fulfillment.
